landing.title: Qio
landing.documentTitle: Qio — In-person queues, nothing to install
landing.metaDescription: Create your venue’s queue and get a QR code. Customers join from the browser with no app, follow their position in real time and are notified when it is their turn.

hero.sub: Customers scan the QR code, join from the browser and follow their position on their phone. You call the next one from the app.
hero.note: For customers: no account, no app, no sign-up.

items.b: Customers open the QR code link in the browser. It works on any phone.
Position and estimated wait update instantly, with no page reload.
When a ticket is called, the phone shows a screen, vibrates and can get a notification.
Portuguese, English and Spanish, with light and dark mode.
Scan the QR code or open the link, enter a name and you are in. No account, no app.
items.alt: Join-the-queue screen on the customer’s phone

items.b: The ticket, the position in line and the estimated wait stay on screen, updated in real time.
items.alt: Ticket #5, 5th in line and an estimated 40-minute wait

items.b: Full screen, sound and vibration when the ticket is called. Nobody misses a turn watching the counter.
items.alt: Green "It is your turn" screen with the called ticket

items.b: Call next, call again, mark served or no-show. The queue’s QR and link are one tap away.
items.alt: Venue dashboard with QR code and Call next button

items.b: Customers served, average wait, no-shows and peak hours for each queue.

care.title: Built with care

items.b: Just a name and, optionally, a phone. Access is anonymous.
The number stays with the venue. Other customers never see it.
Visits and ratings are deleted after 180 days by default.
The owner finds, exports and erases a customer’s data by phone.
Delete a queue or the whole account, with its data.
With an opt-out and Do Not Track support.
